hero.title: Safe asbestos inspection and removal
hero.subtitle: We protect your property, your team, and your environment with controlled professional processes.
hero.description: We provide evaluation, containment, removal, and controlled handling of asbestos-containing materials in roofs, walls, pipes, sheets, and other surfaces. We work with safety protocols, proper equipment, and a preventive approach.
checklist.title: Safety checklist
checklist.note: Ideal for homes, warehouses, businesses, clinics, and remodeling projects.
about.title: About Us
about.text: We are a team specialized in the evaluation, handling, and safe removal of asbestos-containing materials. Our approach prioritizes environmental safety, work area control, and risk reduction throughout every stage of the service.

services.title: Services
services.item1.name: Material inspection
services.item1.text: Visual area assessment and identification of suspect materials in roofs, walls, pipes, and structures.
services.item2.name: Area containment
services.item2.text: Isolation of the work zone to reduce spread and protect nearby people.
services.item3.name: Safe removal
services.item3.text: Controlled removal of asbestos-containing materials using safe procedures and protective equipment.
services.item4.name: Packing and handling
services.item4.text: Proper packaging of removed material for controlled handling and corresponding transport.
services.item5.name: Residential and commercial service
services.item5.text: We serve homes, warehouses, stores, buildings, clinics, factories, and remodeling projects.
services.item6.name: Preventive assessment
services.item6.text: Recommendations for future handling, safer remodeling, and control of potentially risky areas.
